summary: Checked all 29 estimates against the paper and the extraction rules/codebook. Read the complete markdown conversion through the final SI references, covering all 57 PDF pages, and extracted the cited PDF pages with PyMuPDF. Recovered Tables S4 and S7 with find_tables. All 16 recorded regression coefficient/SE cells, their significance bounds, the two rounded main-text differences, and the nine contrasts containing arm means and confidence intervals match the printed outcomes and arms. All 106 numeric source fields were also checked directly against their cited PDF pages. The four remaining records correctly retain null statistics for narrative or figure-only comparisons. Printed regression directions are correctly documented, including coefficients that are control minus treatment under the extraction arm ordering. The four mechanical flags are false positives caused by numbered B prefixes in the PDF text layer. PDF p. 48 (printed SI p. 32), Table S4, prints originality -0.0409 (0.103) for Human Creativity minus Human Confirmation; and interestingness -0.0417 (0.110), writing quality -0.0992 (0.096), and coherence -0.2314** (0.100) for Copilot minus Human Creativity. The extracted quotes retain the literal prefixes 7B, 29B, 31B and 33B; these prefixes are not part of the numbers. No analysis-specific people counts for the two-arm contrasts are printed, so the null counts are appropriate. The cohort, story totals, survey counts and rating totals are not interchangeable. Quality regressions are explicitly evaluation-level; the paper does not state participant clustering. The similarity captions specify a score per story but do not describe how the confidence intervals were calculated or how shared group-reference dependence was handled, supporting retention of unclear for their uncertainty basis. Genre-vector similarity is fully described in measure_detail; the available measure vocabulary has no exact category for cosine similarity of binary genre vectors. The question, construct, measure descriptions, unit, direction, AI availability, timing, within-person status and comparison type are consistent with the reported analyses. All eligible Day 2 AI-design outcomes and contrasts are represented. The fixed-order Day 1 comparisons, self-reports, subgroup/skill associations, post-outcome rating associations and autonomous-model DAT benchmark are appropriately excluded. No missing in-scope estimate or confirmed extraction error was found.
